items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I was writing for a White band in Detroit named Bobby Lippert.

ctx.x: Also, once you first heard your arrangements played, then did you get an idea of how to do the next thing?
Yeah. Well, I was writing for a White band in Detroit named Bobby Lippert.
